tree.title: Add a tree
tree.description:
Name the tree ("Golden by the fence", "Cherry on the terrace") and pick its species: the displayed name combines both, so trees stay distinguishable in every list.

The stage advances automatically from accumulated growing degree days, and you are notified each time. You can always correct it by hand — your correction takes precedence. The offset recalibrates the model if your orchard is consistently ahead (positive) or behind (negative) the table.
